mentions.name: Tekushi
mentions.description: Browser-based simulation game that trains players to detect online threats and dark patterns in a safe environment, applying martial arts principles to online self-defense against current online threats. Built with Python/Flask.
mentions.problem: People need to learn to recognize current online threats and dark patterns; the project applies martial arts principles to online safety training.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm building a simulation training to master online self-defense.

I take the principles of martial art and apply it to online safety against all the current threats.

This is a browser-based simulation game where you train and learn detecting threats and dark patterns in a safe environment.
